data.scope: Seven black-box test methods in tests/test_fd032_risk_decision_blackbox.py and their subcases; adaptive single/escalated decisions, complementary focus, vote threshold, Reviewer identity isolation, and legacy compatibility.
data.side_effects: Creates, mutates, and cleans temporary Git repositories and FD fixture files under the system temporary directory. No expected workspace writes; an interrupted run may leave a temporary directory.
data.risk_review: Inspected the invoked test module and its FD-014 fixture. The fixture copies the CLI and FD template to a TemporaryDirectory, runs local git init and CLI subprocesses there, and disables Python bytecode writes. No network, download, privilege change, external service, or release artifact is expected.
